test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All oranges are mangoes.

2. All mangoes are apples.

3. All apples are grapes.

**Conclusions:**

1. All mangoes are grapes.

II. All apples are oranges.

III. All oranges are grapes.

IV. All grapes are mangoes.

options.text: Only conclusions III and IV follow.
Only conclusions I and II follow.
Only conclusions I and III follow.
Only conclusions II and III follow.

solution:
The least possible venn diagram is shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4340d3e80e5d16570f4d65f9cd3865477dc799912e94323cba40c37441f0503.png] 

Conclusions:

1. All mangoes are grapes → **True** (All mangoes are apples, and all apples are grapes implies that all mangoes are grapes).

II. All apples are oranges → **False** (All oranges are mangoes and all mangoes are apples implies that it is possible that all apples are oranges but it is not definite).

III. All oranges are grapes → **True **(All oranges are mangoes, all mangoes are apples and all apples are grapes implies that all oranges are grapes).

IV. All grapes are mangoes → **False** (All oranges are mangoes, all mangoes are apples and all apples are grapes implies that it is possible that all grapes are mangoes but it is not definite).

Hence, the correct answer is **"****Only conclusions I and III follow"**.
